2.88.17
Chart.ChartSeriesHierarchy
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Chart.ChartSeriesHierarchy element specifies the hierarchy of series members in a Chart. This
element MUST be specified. This element is of type ChartHierarchy.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.ChartSeriesHierarchy element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ChartSeriesHierarchy element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartSeriesHierarchy" type="ChartHierarchyType" />
